depth_justification: The copilot emits the identical templated [GDPR.P1.D4] paragraph for every turn, completely ignoring the developer's specific disclosures (no k-anonymity, 15-20 person cohorts, coerced workplace consent, unnecessary journal text, A/B-testing data bleed, equity gaps, no retention/breach plan). Nothing references THIS app's actual choices, data flows, or the real regulatory problems raised.
actionability_justification: It offers only vague, repeated platitudes ('must be lawfully based', 'requires a DPIA', 'audited to ensure it is compliant') with no concrete steps; the requested structured report degenerates into the same block copy-pasted four times and truncates mid-sentence, giving the developer nothing implementable.
